en.html:
Chachamaru"Morning, bhai."
Kageaki"Good morning."
Chachamaru"Lovely weather again today."
Kageaki"Is it? The washing should dry well."
Chachamaru"Fine development."
Kageaki"Yes."
Chachamaru"............"
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"Man and woman staring each other down, first thing in the morning."
Kageaki"Have we met somewhere before?"
Chachamaru"No memory?"
Kageaki"I am ashamed to say so."
Chachamaru"After sharing the same disaster and all."
Kageaki"Which is why, since a little while ago, I have been thinking hard enough to bring my brain to the boil."
Chachamaru"Still no memory."
Kageaki"No. Something does... faintly touch the memory."
Chachamaru"Does it, now?"
Kageaki"..."
Chachamaru"..."
Chachamaru"Morning staring competition, and nobody has even announced the rules."
Kageaki"A misunderstanding. To begin with, where is this, and why am I here?"
Chachamaru"That also you do not remember?"
Kageaki"............"

en.html: —That black vortex swallowed me... No. Not quite. I lost consciousness just before that. I could not imagine being swallowed by it and remaining unharmed. Not one cell would be left by now—◆which meant Silver Star must have released the technique before then. And afterwards... Afterwards?
en.text:
—That black vortex swallowed me...

No. Not quite.

I lost consciousness just before that. I could not imagine being swallowed by it and remaining unharmed. Not one cell would be left by now—◆which meant Silver Star must have released the technique before then.

And afterwards...
Afterwards?

en.html:
Kageaki"...I remember where I was and what I was doing before I lost consciousness."
Chachamaru"But that does not connect to here."
Kageaki"Yes."
Chachamaru"Cannot be helped, maybe."
Kageaki"Why?"
Chachamaru"Because apun carried you here on her own authority, while you were lying unconscious."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"Meaning... you were at that place?"
Chachamaru"Yes."
Kageaki"...Hachimangu at that time?"
Chachamaru"Very difficult day, boss."
Chachamaru"Nearly got swallowed by that black thing myself... Frightening? That word was not doing its work."
Chachamaru"You know when you pull the bath plug, and shed hairs go down with the water? Full understanding of their feelings now."
Kageaki"......................................Indeed."
Chachamaru"Trauma material, that."
Chachamaru"While you people were having your excitement overhead, apun was quietly in mortal danger below. Yes, yes! Fought for my life with nobody even watching!"
Chachamaru"Remembered it and became sad. Very sad..."
Kageaki"...I have put you to considerable trouble."
Chachamaru"No, no. Afterwards I picked up you and Muramasa and ran before somebody spotted us."
Chachamaru"That part was not so much trouble. Compared with the drain-escape game beforehand."
Kageaki"..."

en.html:
My insides froze—but only for an instant.

The bond between pilot and tsurugi told me.
—Dormant.

Probably, after suffering such severe damage, she had shut down every function except regeneration and was concentrating on recovery. Serious enough, certainly. For the moment, however, not the worst possible condition.

I let out a relieved breath.

ja.html:
肝が氷結したのは、一瞬の間の事に過ぎなかった。

　仕手と劒冑の<ruby>結縁<rt>リンク</rt></ruby>が教える。
　――休眠中だ。

　深い損傷を負ったため、再生以外の全機能を封じて
回復に努めているのだろう。
　それはそれで無論のこと由々しき事態だが、とりあ
えず最悪の状態ではない。

　俺はほっと息をついた。

en.html:
Chachamaru"Worried about your tsurugi, are you?"
Kageaki"She is my partner."
Chachamaru"Hmph."
Kageaki"Something wrong?"
Chachamaru"Hearing those words from you makes apun's heart feel a little scratched up."
Kageaki"...Why would that be?"
Chachamaru"An emotion arising from personal circumstances, sir. Wooden fellow."
Kageaki"...?"
Chachamaru"Well then. Bhai, have you begun to work out who apun is, and where this is?"
Kageaki"..."
Kageaki"You spoke Muramasa's name."
Chachamaru"Spoke it, yes."
Kageaki"Then you are connected with me. Or else—"
Kageaki"Connected with Silver Star. ...Possibly both."
Chachamaru"Only two genuine works of Sengo Uemon-no-jou Muramasa left, after all."
Kageaki"..."

en.html:
Kageaki"And you were at Hachimangu then."
Chachamaru"Yes."
Kageaki"During the sword-offering pilgrimage—a major rite at which outsiders were not permitted."
Chachamaru"Quite right."
Kageaki"...There is something I have wondered for some time. she is listed as missing nationwide. Why has no news of her whereabouts appeared?"
Kageaki"For two whole years. Might this not show that some powerful person is sheltering her...?"
Chachamaru"Sound reasoning."
Kageaki"...Judging by this room... we are inside a mansion of considerable standing."
Chachamaru"Nothing so grand. Ah, that is modesty, haan? Your deduction is correct."
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"please."
Kageaki"You belong to the shogunate's leadership."
Chachamaru"Chachamaru Ashikaga, Kubou of Horigoe. Suppose a 'pleased to meet you' is required at this point."
Chachamaru"Bhai."
Kageaki"————————"
Chachamaru"..."
Kageaki"............"
Chachamaru"Hungry?"
Kageaki"...That appears to be the case."
Chachamaru"Then breakfast first, no?"
